summary: CohortRotations enables users to view, add, edit, delete, and copy rotation records associated with course timetables. The feature is used for managing cohort rotation schedules, with business rules and validations enforced for rotation start/end dates relative to course/timetable boundaries. The UI supports error handling, validation summaries, modal popups, and user interaction depending on read-only or edit mode.
purpose: To allow users (administrators/staff) to manage the rotation schedule for cohorts on a course timetable, ensuring valid date entries, supporting copying rotations from other courses, and enforcing business rules regarding date boundaries.

workflows.name: Manage Cohort Rotations
steps: Page loads and initializes required scripts and localization resources.
User selects a timetable (TimetableID). Data sources are configured for the header and rotations.
Grid displays rotations with columns: Count, StartDate, EndDate.
User can Add, Edit, Delete, or Copy rotations depending on permission (ScreenIsEditable).
Adding: Defaults StartDate based on existing rotation or timetable start. EndDate is bounded by timetable.
Editing: Retrieves the entry from GridView, populates detail form.
Copying: User chooses a source timetable, invokes CopyRotations.
Saving: Validates date fields (required, valid format, business rules). Updates or adds the record.
UI panels show errors, warnings, and validation results.
Modal popups are used for editing details.
Field variables and client-side scripts are setup for validation.

business_rules: Rotation start and end dates must not be before timetable/course start date.
Rotation start and end dates must not be after timetable/course end date.
EndDate must not be before StartDate.
StartDate and EndDate must match required format and be present.
User must not be in ViewOnly mode to edit/copy/add rotations.
validations: CustomValidator: Rotation dates not before course start date (checkBeforeTimetableStartDate).
CustomValidator: Rotation dates not after course end date (checkAfterTimetableEndDate).
calculations: When adding a new rotation, StartDate defaults to timetable start or last rotation's EndDate + 1.
EndDate is bounded by timetable end.
conditions: If timetableID is not selected or invalid, certain panels are hidden.
CopyRotations panel is visible only if grid has no rows and screen is editable.
If errors or warnings exist, corresponding panels display appropriate information.
system_behavior: Handles async postbacks for updating panel content.
Error and warning panels are shown/hidden based on system state.
Modal popups manage editing state for details view.
Validation summary is available for error aggregation.
Field variables are setup in client-side JavaScript for validation logic.
exceptions: Invalid date format results in validation errors.
Deletion/edition fails if entry cannot be found.
Copy from timetable fails if no options available.
content_gaps: No explicit database schema for TimetableRotation entity (fields inferred from UI/code).
No details for user roles or permissions beyond ViewOnly logic.
Some referenced resources (localization strings, included JS files) are not included.
There is limited detail on UI layout and styling, only partial markup and code is available.
